easyPrerequisites: Incubation Druid has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Incubation Druid by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color a land you control could produce.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Incubation Druid.
Repeat.
